word_cut.description: Three different real paper-cutting strokes from Joseph Sardin Scissors Cutting Paper4, joined by the recorded reopening and paper feed. No knife/metal-click substitute or generated noise.
word_cut.processing: HP120/160Hz; LP2400-3300Hz; separate9ms soft cut attacks, quiet reopening, smooth peak rounding, final LP3300Hz;1.04s total.

ingredient_add.description: Entire main natural splash and settling ripples from a real small-stone water recording. Water is the sole sound source; no wood impact, synthesized tone, or added electronic bubble.
ingredient_add.processing: Speed1.03, HP90Hz/LP3600Hz,12ms onset/95ms release; smoothed10ms water envelope compression(max quiet-body gain3.5), smooth peak rounding and final LP3600Hz;0.68s total.

ingredient_remove.description: Water-only lifting gesture: reversed splash tail rises, short natural runoff, then two separate real water fragments at.325/.495s. Designed composite, not a literal recording of lifting ingredients. No wooden tray contact or synthesized body tone.
ingredient_remove.processing: HP110-140Hz/LP3200-3500Hz; soft envelopes, smoothed10ms water envelope compression(max quiet-body gain3.5), smooth peak rounding, final LP3500Hz;0.72s total.

processing.word_select: One short supported paper touch, with a very small fiber flex at.026s; smooth tanh peak rounding. No metal, water, sustained slide, pitched chime or magic tail; shorter and quieter than cutting or inserting a card.

synthesis: No new tones or synthetic noise in this revision. All three revised sounds use recorded scissors/paper or water. The unchanged card selection is a byte copy of its prior processed CC0 paper composite.
dependencies: Python, numpy, scipy, soundfile with MP3 support; no new installation.
